_설명: 천일문 3권 Chapter 03 수동태에서 가져와 변형한 문항. 은행에서는 심화 5과 수동태 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: The park ______ by volunteers every weekend.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: A new library ______ in our town next spring.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 수동태로 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: Nora belongs to a book club.
Many children love cats as pets.
My key often disappears in the house.
My aunt became a manager of a hotel.
After heavy snow, accidents can occur easily.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 (A), (B)를 바르게 고쳐 쓴 것끼리 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: • Hangeul (A) [[taught]] to many students by Ms. Kim.
• The sign (B) [[can see]] well even in the fog.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 (A), (B)를 바르게 고쳐 쓴 것끼리 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: • Bees (A) [[consider]] busy by many people.
• The storm (B) [[happen]] suddenly last night.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장을 수동태 문장으로 바꿔 쓰세요.
body: The teacher locked the doors after the class.
→ ________________ after the class.
questions.answer: The doors were locked by the teacher

questions.prompt: 다음 문장을 수동태 문장으로 바꿔 쓰세요.
body: Students should return the books by Friday.
questions.answer: The books should be returned by students

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: I’m worried about my math grade.
The papers and cans can be recycled.
When Mia was six, her little brother was born.
The player is expected to win the match by his fans.
The girl called a genius when she solved the puzzle in a minute.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: The show was watched by many people.
Soup was made for me by Dad.
These statues in the museum must be move carefully.
A new album will be released by the singer next month.
A warm lunch is being made by my sister in the kitchen.

questions.point_label: be filled with, be known for
questions.prompt: 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: • The café is always filled ______(A) the smell of fresh coffee.
• The writer is known ______(B) writing short poems.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 문장의 전환이 올바르지 않은 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: You can bake bread with this recipe. → Bread can be baked with this recipe by you.
He gave the letter to my brother. → The letter was given to my brother by him.
I often put off my chores until later. → My chores are often put off by me until later.
The students carried out a project for their class. → A project was carried out the students for their class.
The children gave the teacher some cards on Teacher’s Day. → Some cards were given to the teacher by the children on Teacher’s Day.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요.
body: 그 연극의 입장권이 지금 온라인에서 판매되는 중이다. (sell)
→ Tickets for the play ________________ online now.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요.
body: 이 셔츠는 손으로 세탁되어야 한다. (should, wash)
→ This shirt ________________ by hand.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장의 개수를 고르세요.
body: ⓐ Am I allowed to leave now?
ⓑ These plants should watered daily.
ⓒ She has never been inviting to such a big party.
ⓓ The thief was caught by the police.
ⓔ The street was blocked because of the parade.
ⓕ The windows were broken by the storm.

questions.prompt: 다음 글에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: If you are interested in fantasy novels, try reading The Hobbit. It’s known for its rich world and lovely characters. The book can being enjoyed by you and all the readers.
